title: Do Ethical AI Principles Matter to Users? A Large-Scale Analysis of User Sentiment and Satisfaction

bias_targets.methodology: Sentiment analysis of over 100,000 user reviews of AI products using a fine-tuned RoBERTa model to detect discussions of 'Diversity, Non-discrimination, and Fairness.' The study evaluates how user perceptions of unjust bias and lack of fairness correlate with overall user satisfaction.
